component: P16 immutable offline task/input snapshot composition
constraints: Exact bytes for task/envelope/policy and an exact tuple of at most sixteen exact byte blobs; per-part ceiling 65536 bytes and task-specific evidence budget.
Stable bytes across hash checks, parsing and fresh verification; bounded metadata output preserves signed failed/unknown outcomes.
No transport, device SDK, executor, cache, memory-pool or hard real-time contract. Input-byte bounds are not process-memory bounds.
alternatives: CPython immutable bytes/tuple with explicit exact-type admission and composition of public verifiers.
Rust shared immutable borrowing with ownership and foreign-buffer aliasing reviewed explicitly.
Java/Kotlin immutable protobuf ByteString containers without changing the existing JSON wire profile.
C#/F# owned storage exposed through ReadOnlyMemory, with mutable backing aliases excluded or copied.
rationale: KEEP exact immutable snapshots and public verification composition: every digest and subsequent parse sees the same admitted byte values, and signature/policy checks remain in one verified boundary.
Native ownership and managed immutable containers can also satisfy this contract. No mandatory IPC or buffer-copy penalty is assumed for them.

Eleven bundle methods pass, including six revocation/kind combinations, expiry boundaries and discarded partial results. Removing the envelope-pin comparison in a temporary module makes the existing input-pin test fail.
No measured target workload establishes a material native or managed-runtime advantage. Installation, incumbent language and rewrite effort are not selection criteria.
limits: Caller pins and time/revision floors must be authenticated externally; these APIs do not enroll callers, persist floors, discover revocations or prevent replay.
No comparative performance benchmark or full alternate-runtime implementation was executed; no winning migration is being deferred.
Saved results are ordinary metadata snapshots, not self-expiring authorization tokens. No motion, execution or evidence qualification follows.
No target hardware, deadline or RSS envelope is specified. Insufficient information for tactical deployment.
The bundle parses admitted task bytes again; this is safe under the exact immutable-input contract, not a claim that repeated parsing is free.
No completion-time clock is sampled. The reported expiry is the minimum task/passport/policy expiry at caller-supplied time.
